[name]
Milwaukee, WI · [email] · [phone] · [url]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Investment banking associate with five years at Robert W. Baird & Co. in the Industrial Technology group. Ten closed transactions totaling approximately $3.0 billion in aggregate value; named roles on each below. CFA charterholder. Manage two analysts and run the group's model-review process.

EXPERIENCE

Robert W. Baird & Co., Investment Banking, Industrial Technology — Milwaukee, WI
Associate (Jul 2023 – Present) · Analyst (Jul 2020 – Jun 2023)

Selected closed transactions (deal value, my role):
• Sale of a privately held flow-control components manufacturer to a strategic acquirer, $640M — day-to-day associate: built the operating model, ran the data room, drafted the CIM, managed the buyer list of 61 parties through two rounds.
• Sell-side advisory for a sponsor-owned test and measurement business, $520M — lead analyst then associate on the model; coordinated quality-of-earnings workstream with the accountants.
• Buy-side advisory for a public industrial automation company acquiring a software add-on, $410M — associate: accretion/dilution analysis, synergy case, board materials.
• Sale of a founder-owned sensor manufacturer to a private equity sponsor, $385M — day-to-day associate across 14 management presentations.
• Follow-on equity offering for a listed industrial technology company, $300M — analyst: comparable company analysis and roadshow materials.
• Minority recapitalization of a family-owned instrumentation business by a growth fund, $220M — lead analyst: model and valuation materials.
• Four additional sell-side mandates between $90M and $180M each (closed 2021–2024), analyst or associate on the model for each.

Responsibilities and outcomes:
• Manage two first-year analysts: weekly model reviews, staffing, and mid-year reviews; both received top-half rankings in the 2025 analyst review.
• Run the group's model-review checklist, adopted by the 12-person deal team in 2024; model-error findings by the senior review dropped from an average of 6 per deal to 2.
• Built the group's standard LBO template in 2022, still in use; reduced first-draft model build time from about 3 days to 1.
• Prepared or reviewed 30+ pitch books; two pitches converted into mandates in 2025 ($180M and $220M).
• Ranked in the top bucket of the associate class in 2024.
• Lead the associate-level relationship with three sponsor clients between processes: quarterly portfolio updates and buyer-universe refreshes for 11 portfolio companies.
• Coordinate the group's summer analyst program: staffing, the two-week modeling training, and final reviews for a class of four in 2024 and six in 2025.
• Co-authored the group's 2025 industrial technology sector outlook (28 pages, distributed to about 300 sponsor and corporate clients).
• Serve on the firm's analyst recruiting committee for the Midwest schools; conducted about 60 first-round interviews over three recruiting seasons.

Transaction experience by type (2020–2025): six sell-side M&A, two buy-side M&A, one follow-on equity offering, one minority recapitalization. Counterparties included strategic acquirers, large-cap and middle-market private equity sponsors, and growth funds.

Baird — Summer Analyst, Investment Banking (Jun 2019 – Aug 2019)
• Supported a sell-side process for an industrial distributor; built the precedent transactions analysis.

EDUCATION
University of Wisconsin–Madison, Wisconsin School of Business — B.B.A., Finance, Investment and Banking, May 2020
GPA 3.7/4.0. Investment Banking Club, vice president (2019–2020): organized the annual Chicago bank trek for 40 students and the spring modeling workshop series.
Applied Security Analysis Program, student-managed fund (2019–2020): industrials analyst; covered four names.

COMMUNITY
Volunteer tax preparer, VITA program, Milwaukee (2022–2025): about 25 returns a season.
Mentor, Wisconsin School of Business alumni mentoring program (2023–present): three mentees placed in banking or corporate finance roles.

CERTIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
CFA Charterholder (2024). FINRA Series 79 and 63.
Financial modeling (LBO, merger, DCF, operating models), valuation, due diligence coordination, Capital IQ, FactSet, Bloomberg, Excel VBA, PowerPoint.
Sector coverage: flow control, test and measurement, automation software, sensors and instrumentation.
